mapper.insert: insert into stock_restore_compensation (order_no, stock_items_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message) values (#{orderNo}, #{stockItemsJson}, 0, 0, now(), #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: select id, order_no, stock_items_json, status, retry_count, error_message, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time from stock_restore_compensation where status = 0 and next_retry_time <= now() order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update stock_restore_compensation set status = 0, retry_count = #{retryCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = 1
